parameters.help_en: The ID of the task corresponding to the request
parameters.name: instance_job_id

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
GmtCreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间。ISO8601 格式的 UTC 时间
GmtCreateTime.title_en: 创建 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601
GmtCreateTime.title_zh: 创建 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601

InstanceId.description_en: Instance ID of the task instance. For example, in a task that creates a custom role, this is instance ID of the generated role
InstanceId.description_zh: 任务实例ID。例如在创建自定义角色的任务中是生成的角色ID

ReasonMessage.description_en: The detailed description of the task
ReasonMessage.title_en: 项目空间名称， region 内唯一
ReasonMessage.title_zh: 项目空间名称， region 内唯一

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
Creating: The task is being created.
Updating: The task is being updated.
Deleting: The task is being deleted.
Successful: The task succeeded. This is a desired state.
Failed: The task failed. This is a desired state
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。可取值：
Creating：创建中
Updating：更新中
Deleting：删除中
Successful：成功（终态）
Failed：失败（终态）

Type.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:
CreateWorkspaceCustomRole
UpdateWorkspaceCustomRole
DeleteWorkspaceCustomRole
Type.description_zh:
任务类型。取值：
CreateWorkspaceCustomRole
UpdateWorkspaceCustomRole
DeleteWorkspaceCustomRole
Type.title_en: 修改 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601
